_comment: Hand-placed destinations of "Via X" timetable notes that OpenStreetMap cannot resolve by name (key = normalised name). A key may hold several namesakes: the one that lies on the route of the line is used. Shown on the map and in the stop list for the trips carrying the note. Positions are place/stop centres from OpenStreetMap (Nominatim), not surveyed bus stops.
